sections.label: Active Mobility Act regulations and PMD incidents
sections.summary: Regulations on device criteria and user behaviour were put in place, with 228 PMD accidents in 2017-2018 and 52 PMD-related fires in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Upon AMAP’s recommendation, we put in place a comprehensive framework of regulations on device criteria and user behaviour through the Active Mobility Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: There have been 228 reported accidents involving PMDs on public paths in 2017 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: There were 52 PMD-related fires reported in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The number was 49 in the first half of this year.

sections.label: UL2272 mandatory fire safety requirement
sections.summary: LTA made UL2272 mandatory for PMDs in September 2018, and all PMD-related fire incidents have involved non-UL2272 certified devices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In September 2018, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced UL2272 as a mandatory requirement for PMDs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To date, we are still the only country in the world to impose such a rigorous fire safety requirement for e-scooters.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Thus far, all PMD-related fire incidents have involved non-UL2272 certified devices and may have involved inappropriate charging practices, such as the use of incompatible chargers, overloading of sockets or charging near flammable materials.

sections.label: Earlier UL2272 deadline and inspection regime
sections.summary: LTA will bring forward the UL2272 compliance deadline to 1 July 2020 and introduce mandatory inspections for registered e-scooters from 1 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, given the recent spate of PMD-related fires, LTA will take two further steps to address the situation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will bring forward by six months, the deadline for compliance with the UL2272 requirement, to 1 July 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This will also give retailers time to bring in a sufficient stock of UL2272-certified devices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will also introduce a mandatory inspection regime for registered e-scooters from 1 April 2020 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA will, henceforth, require all new e-scooters to pass inspections for UL2272 certification and width, weight and device speed before they can be registered.

sections.label: Active mobility infrastructure improvement fund
sections.summary: A fund estimated at $50 million will expand active mobility infrastructure and expedite improvements in accident hotspots.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To meet growing needs, we will expand our active mobility infrastructure improvement plans and expedite them in hotspots where accidents often occur.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We are setting aside a fund to tackle such hotspots, by making appropriate improvements, such as widening footpaths, installing clear warning signs, and installing speed regulating strips on the paths to slow down PMD users.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: These efforts are estimated to cost us $50 million to implement over the next few years.

sections.label: Town Councils ban PMDs in common areas
sections.summary: After further discussions, 15 Town Councils decided to ban PMD usage in void decks and common corridors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: After further discussions, 15 Town Councils have decided to ban the usage of PMDs in void decks and common corridors.

sections.label: Trial pedestrian-only zones for PMDs
sections.summary: LTA will work with Town Councils on a three-month trial of pedestrian-only zones at four town centres and one neighbourhood centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To address this risk, LTA will work with the relevant Town Councils to conduct a three-month trial to designate pedestrian-only zones (POZs) where riders must dismount and push their PMDs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will try out POZs at the town centres in Ang Mo Kio, Bedok, Bukit Batok and Khatib, and at a neighbourhood centre in Tampines.

sections.label: Cycling path network expansion
sections.summary: The cycling path network will be expanded to 750 km by 2025 and tripled by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This is not enough to support first-mile-last-mile commutes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will expand the cycling path network to 750 km by 2025 and triple our cycling network by 2030.

sections.label: Enforcement team expansion
sections.summary: Enforcement resources have more than doubled since May 2019 and the team will grow to about 200 by year end.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since May 2019, we have more than doubled our enforcement resources.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will continue to ramp up and will enlarge the enforcement team to about 200 by the end of this year.

sections.label: PMD insurance recommendations
sections.summary: AMAP will submit recommendations later this year, likely starting with third-party liability insurance for PMD-sharing operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: AMAP will submit its recommendations to the Government later this year after consulting the relevant stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will likely start off by requiring PMD-sharing operators to have third-party liability insurance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Meanwhile, major food delivery companies like Deliveroo and GrabFood are already providing third-party liability insurance for their riders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: FoodPanda also announced this morning that they will be doing so starting from next month.

sections.label: Safe riding programme participation
sections.summary: Over 57,000 people joined SRP as of June 2019, including over 1,000 volunteers who patrol and share safe riding practices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As of June 2019, over 57,000 people have participated in SRP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will continue to work with the community to develop a gracious and safe path sharing culture.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This includes over 1,000 volunteers who regularly patrol and share safe riding practices with their community.

sections.label: PMD fire safety deadline
sections.summary: MOT brought forward the UL2272 compliance deadline by six months and set a mandatory inspection regime from 1 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOT is very mindful of the fire safety concerns about PMDs and we have studied this issue very, very carefully and consulted various stakeholders for the decision to bring forward the deadline for complying with the UL2272 standard by six months as well as for the mandatory inspection regime from 1 April 2020.

sections.label: PMD retailer timeline and fire education
sections.summary: Retailers confirmed 1 July 2020 as reasonable, and LTA will work with SCDF on PMD fire safety education.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Our discussions with some of the PMD retailers, especially with the PMD Retailers Association of Singapore, has also confirmed that 1 July 2020 is a reasonable timeline as it gives retailers sufficient time to bring in UL2272-certified devices so that you can have a smooth replacement scheme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, we also understand that many of the causes of PMD-related fires can be attributed to other factors, such as improper charging practices, the use of incompatible chargers or adapters.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As such, LTA will be working very closely with SCDF to step up fire safety education on PMDs.

sections.label: Stiffer action against non-compliant retailers
sections.summary: The question asks whether stiffer action can be taken against retailers selling non-compliant batteries or PMDs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: The other question I have for the Senior Minister of State is: can we take stiffer action against retailers that sell non-compliant batteries or PMDs?

sections.label: Singapore PMD safety measures
sections.summary: Singapore is the only country with the UL2272 standard for e-scooters and the first with mandatory PMD registration and a coming inspection regime.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And I also would like to reiterate that safety is of paramount importance and we will take all feedback seriously.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Thus far, Singapore remains the only country that has implemented the UL2272 standard for e-scooters and this had been a bold and decisive move in September 2018 to deal with the potential issues of fire safety.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We are also the first country to introduce a mandatory registration as well as, soon, a mandatory inspection regime for PMDs with regard to the weight, width, motorised speed as well as the UL2272 requirements.

sections.label: SRP attendance numbers
sections.summary: More than 57,000 individuals have attended SRP to date.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To date, we have more than 57,000 individuals who have already attended SRP.

sections.label: AMAP speed limit recommendations
sections.summary: AMAP recently recommended to MOT reducing active mobility device speed limits on footpaths from 15 km/h to 10 km/h and to 25 km/h on shared paths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to the speed limit of devices on various paths, AMAP has recently recommended to MOT to reduce the speed limit of active mobility devices, including bicycles, on footpaths from 15 km per hour (h) to 10 km/h, and 25 km/h along shared paths.

sections.label: Reducing period to three months
sections.summary: After discussing with Town Council chairmen, they decided to bring it down to three months to know its effectiveness more quickly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: After discussing with the Town Council chairmen, we have decided to bring it down to three months because we want to know its effectiveness more quickly.

sections.label: Registered PMD owners in database
sections.summary: There are 90,000 people with registered PMDs in the database, and only a small number are irresponsible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Right now, we have 90,000 people who have registered PMDs in our database, and we know that only a small number of them are irresponsible.

sections.label: Crowdsourcing PMD incident reports
sections.summary: LTA started a crowdsourcing application with a Report PMD/PAB Incident function in MyTransport.SG, letting Singaporeans photograph errant riders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA has started what we call a "crowdsourcing application".

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I think Members would have read in the papers about the "Report PMD/PAB Incident" function within the MyTransport.SG application.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This will allow any Singaporean to take a picture of any errant riders that they may encounter.

sections.label: Enforcement officers and hotspot information
sections.summary: The application gives information on potential hotspots for stepped-up enforcement, and enforcement officers will increase to about 200 by year end.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But this will also give us good information on some of these areas that are potentially hotspots and then we can step up enforcement actions, whether physically or otherwise, at these places.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I have also mentioned in my Ministerial Statement that we will be increasing the number of enforcement officers (AMEOs), up to about 200 by the end of this year.

sections.label: Technology in enforcement efforts
sections.summary: Technology will be harnessed in enforcement, including piloting mobile CCTVs at certain hotspots and using video analytics for enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, we will also see how we can harness technology in our enforcement efforts, one of which I have explained in my Statement, which is piloting the use of mobile CCTVs at certain hotspots and see how we can use video analytics for the enforcement actions.

sections.label: Registered PMDs and UL2272 certification
sections.summary: Of 90,000 registered PMDs, 10% are declared UL2272-certified, so 90% are non-compliant; the deadline was brought forward six months and mandatory inspection starts 1 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to her clarification on the number of non-compliant PMDs, to date, we have 90,000 PMDs registered in our database, of which 10% have been declared to be UL2272-certified.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: So, we are looking at 90% of these devices that are non-compliant at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Therefore, it is one of the reasons why we have decided to bring forward the deadline for UL2272-certified devices to be used on the ground by only six months, rather than immediately.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, we are also implementing this mandatory inspection regime from 1 April 2020.

sections.label: Covered linkways and $50 million fund
sections.summary: The $50 million fund that will be set up can be used for the crowded covered linkways.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: On the last clarification on the crowded covered linkways and whether we are able to use the $50 million fund that will be set up, the answer is yes.

sections.label: Licence for dockless PMD-sharing
sections.summary: Under the Parking Places Act, operators need a licence to offer dockless PMD-sharing services if users may end rentals in a public space.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Under the Parking Places Act, operators are required to obtain a licence to offer dockless PMD-sharing services if users of PMDs may end PMD rentals in a public space, meaning, outside private premises.

sections.label: Non UL2272 PMD sales offence
sections.summary: From 1 July 2019, companies commit an offence under the Active Mobility Act by selling or leasing non UL2272-certified PMDs for public paths, so all rental PMDs must be certified.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: From 1 July 2019, it is an offence under the Active Mobility Act for companies to sell or lease non UL2272-certified PMDs for use on public paths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: What this means is that all rental PMDs must be UL2272-certified, with no exception.

sections.label: Missing registration information
sections.summary: The speaker states they do not have the information even though registration has been mandatory since 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Unfortunately, we do not have the information even though registration has been mandatory since 1 July this year.

sections.label: Subsidised SRP for riders
sections.summary: Riders are encouraged to go through SRP, which is fully subsidised for all users up to December 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Instead, like I mentioned in my reply to Dr Teo Ho Pin, we encourage all riders to go through SRP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have even fully subsidised SRP for all users if they want to take part in this process, up to December 2019.

sections.label: PMD fire numbers
sections.summary: Last year there were 52 PMD-related fires and from January to July this year there were 49 fires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: As Senior Minister of State Dr Lam mentioned, last year, we had 52 PMD-related fires and, this year, from January to July, we already had 49 fires.

sections.label: PMD fires and device numbers
sections.summary: In 2018 there were 52 cases and in the first half of this year 49 cases, a three-fold increase over the first half of 2018, with devices rising from an estimated 20,000 to 30,000 to 90,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Like he rightly mentioned, in 2018, we had 52 cases and just in the first half of this year, we had 49 cases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But if you look at the same period, that is, comparing the first half of 2019 with the first half of 2018, it is actually a three-fold increase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: When we first started one or two years ago, our rough estimate was about maybe 20,000 to 30,000 devices in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This has increased to 90,000 since we implemented the mandatory registration requirement.

sections.label: Non-certified devices illegal 2020
sections.summary: The use of non UL2272-certified devices on public paths will be illegal from 1 July 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The use of non UL2272-certified devices on public paths will be illegal from 1 July 2020.

sections.label: Battery modification voids UL2272 certification
sections.summary: Illegal modification or changing to a different battery type renders the UL2272 certification void.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Any illegal modification or change to a different type of battery will actually render the UL2272 certification void.

sections.label: Insurance and compensation study for mobility incidents
sections.summary: Faishal Ibrahim and his AMAP will study insurance and compensation for active mobility incidents and submit recommendations later this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Having received many of this feedback, we have actually asked Senior Parliamentary Secretary Assoc Prof Faishal Ibrahim, together with his AMAP, to study this issue of insurance and compensation in the event of any active mobility-related incidents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: They will submit their recommendations later this year, after consulting the various relevant stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But I would also want to say that, at this point in time, we will likely start off by requiring PMD-sharing operators to have mandatory third-party liability insurance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, I have also mentioned just now that the major food delivery companies, like Deliveroo, GrabFood and Food Panda, are and will be providing third-party liability insurance for their riders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In the meantime, we are also working with the insurance companies to see whether we can come up with a more affordable plan for the individual users so that the cost of insurance will not be a great barrier for them to purchase one if they want to at this point in time.

sections.label: Retailers, online platforms and PMD inspections
sections.summary: Twelve retailers were taken to task, LTA works with online platforms on education and removing false advertisements, and about 81,000 PMDs are non-UL2272-certified.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Indeed, there are 12 retailers that have been taken to task.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to the Member's second question, yes, indeed, LTA has been working with online shopping platforms to collaborate on educating our consumers and retailers on the regulations pertaining to the sale and use of PMDs in Singapore and, at the same time, to remove any post of any false advertisements of compliant devices from their platforms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: It may not be possible for us to work with every single online retailer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: It is, therefore, important to have what we have just mentioned, the mandatory inspection regime, to ensure that our PMDs used on our paths meet our technical as well as safety requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: We heard the statistics that the Senior Minister of State shared earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: We assume that there are about 81,000 PMDs out there today which are non UL2272-certified.

sections.label: No intention to license riders
sections.summary: There is no intention at this point in time to license riders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to the Member's second clarification on the licensing of riders, at this point in time, we do not have the intention to do so.

sections.label: Charging PMDs safely and precautions
sections.summary: Charging a PMD is not illegal, but users should take precautions and are encouraged to switch to a UL2272-certified device.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: But this has also caused alarm and concern with their neighbours of potential fire incidents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We would like to clarify that it is not illegal to charge your PMD, whether it is inside your flat or outside.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But what is necessary to know is that you are supposed to exercise the necessary precautions when you are charging your PMD.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Please do not leave it to charge overnight; do not leave it to charge unattended; do exercise the precautions that we mentioned previously; make sure that you do regular inspections of your battery packs to make sure that they are not damaged; and at the same time, please use compatible chargers and Safety Mark labelled adapters.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But, if possible, I would encourage the PMD user to change out to a UL2272-certified device as soon as possible, not only just for your own safety but the safety of your neighbours as well.
